items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Even when Louie Jordan left us and went into the small band

ctx.x: And this was a great year, I'd say. One of the greatest year for music -- the big bands with music -- until then we get into the small bands.
Even when Louie Jordan left us and went into the small band -- they started getting into that small band area -- that was a great year for --
Because you must remember, that was still during the Depression and money was really getting tighter.
